text: hm. im still getting no loop cut through a cylinder. [Image #1] but its not breaking like it was. still, why cant the cylinder top cut
resolution: Matched the cylinder path to js-bench-editor at the topology boundary. New cylinders now use explicit top and bottom center vertices with one real triangle per cap side, so the indexed Loop Cut walk can enter a terminal cap triangle exactly as the reference does instead of stopping at a ReactJIT-only n-gon. Existing cylinders authored with the old convex planar n-gon caps are promoted in-host only when every rim edge proves the cylinder side-quad fan; arbitrary imported n-gons still stop safely. Added TS primitive/traversal coverage and a Zig legacy-cylinder regression; the focused mesh suite is 28/28 and the ReleaseFast editor build passes.
